items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: Yeah, Junior. Oh, yeah. He played in all those bands.

ctx.x: Well, that's Adam's father. And what's his first name, do you remember? Adam Kato. Adam Kato too? Yeah. His father was Adam and his son also Adam.

Yeah, Junior. Oh, yeah. He played in all those bands. All those streets, the parade. Uncle Shatt made all those parades. Yeah. And his brother, my uncle Tapp, he played piano for all those parties. Bow house, what do you call that? Bow house.
I don't have it in this place, I might have it in that other place.
